projects.name: AutoVert
projects.description: Led a team of 4 to build an AI-powered iOS app that provides vehicle diagnostics with 90% accuracy and repair estimates that save users an average of 15%. The app uses advanced machine learning models to analyze vehicle issues and provide detailed repair recommendations.

projects.name: CliquePix
projects.description: Developed a privacy-first photo-sharing web platform with granular permissions and a client-side facial recognition search that reduced media search time by 90%. Built with focus on user privacy and data protection.

projects.name: The Insider Index
projects.description: Deployed an end-to-end platform that processes 1,000+ daily SEC filings to generate insider trading signals, achieving a 5% alpha over market benchmarks in backtests. Features real-time data processing and machine learning predictions.

projects.name: AI Plays Flappy Bird
projects.description: Trained an AI agent using the NEAT reinforcement learning algorithm to master Flappy Bird, increasing its average score from 0 to over 30 within 50 generations. Demonstrates advanced neural network evolution techniques.
